name: Sara Sara Sasara
source:
One day, the main character gets involved in a mission to save God due to some reasons. To save God, he needs to unite with miko both physically and mentally in his dream using the power given from God and strengthens bonds with them. Of course, he can do anything he wants in his dream.... At a different place in a different costume...? He strengthens the bonds with miko like this, but the bonds that only exist in his dream gradually affect his real life...? 

[From [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game.php?game=11930]ErogameScape[/url]]
translation:
某天，主角因为某些原因，被卷入了拯救神的使命中。为了拯救神，他需要利用神赐予的力量，在梦中与巫女在肉体和精神上结合起来，并加强与她们的联系。当然，他可以在梦中做任何他想做的事情……在不同的地方穿着不同的服装……？就这样加强了与巫女的羁绊，但只存在于梦中的羁绊却渐渐影响了他的现实生活……？

[来自[url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game.php?game=11930]ErogameScape[/url]]
